page.overview:
Who is Not Chuck?

Not Chuck is a side character in Cars. He was a pitty that worked for Lightning McQueen's team Rust-eze. He was serving as the temporary crew chief since the previous one quit.

"His name is Not Chuck, not Chucky, not Chuck-meister, not Chaz, not Chet, not Charlie and not Charles. He's a firm believer that a racer is only as good as his tires are fresh, so his motto is, "Change them early and change them often.""

He first appears when Lightning McQueen is making a pit stop at the Motor Speedway of the South. He orders the pitties to change Lightning's tires. McQueen declines getting tires, and orders the crew to only give him gas before he drives back onto the track. Not Chuck, however, angrily yells at him that he needs tires, to which McQueen doesn't listen and results the latter into bursting his rear tires.

After McQueen, The King and Chick Hicks tie in first place, Not Chuck and the pit crew are seen changing McQueen's tires while he is being interviewed by Kori Turbowitz. He then tells Not Chuck to get out of the way of a colored white male SUV cameracar who is trying to get a view of McQueen's bolt sticker on his TV camera. Not Chuck becomes fed up with McQueen's snobbish attitude, and he and the rest of his team later quit. McQueen tells him "Adios, Chuck.", to which he responded, "And my name is not Chuck!"
